clips.title: The story
paras: In the Redridge Mountains, Alther's Mill lies in ruins northeast of Lakeshire. Once it supplied timber to local builders, but now scavengers and predators haunt its grounds. Travelers heading east toward Stonewatch pass this grim mark of the frontier.

Alther's Mill once supplied timber for Lakeshire and the nearby settlements. The clearing northeast of Lake Everstill gave millers access to timber in the mountains. Trouble spread across Stormwind's kingdom, and the Blackrock clan came down from the heights of Stonewatch. The millers abandoned their work, leaving the timber buildings and wheel to decay.

With the workers gone, monstrous tarantulas, carrion vultures, and raiders took over the mill. Travelers on the path to the eastern passes must skirt its shadowed grounds carefully. Shadowy operatives and thieves also use the abandoned compound. Its discarded storage boxes and hidden corners let them practice lockpicking and carry out covert trades beyond the Lakeshire Town Watch's gaze.
